svg.title: Twilio + Amazon Nova Sonic 2.5 architecture
svg.desc: Current runtime architecture: Twilio Media Streams traverse optional CloudFront and ALB to FastAPI on ECS Fargate. Strands owns an identity-first Nova conversation and concurrent tools. A call lifecycle controller coordinates tool barriers, a Nova-only farewell, playback acknowledgement and bounded Twilio termination. Only confirmed termination admits a fixed post-call workflow in a dedicated two-worker executor: regional Sonic token costing, then Luna intelligence and optional AgentCore date resolution. Workers share the application process and are not durable jobs. DynamoDB, secret injection and observability are shown.
svg.text: Outbound collections voice agent / runtime and data flow
Regional resources use AWS_REGION (application default: us-east-1)
VPC · private subnets · NAT gateway for outbound access
PCM in: 16 kHz / PCM out: 24 kHz
Same process · no durable job queue
App → Twilio REST: create / end call, Call details, SMS
Full-width due and nested call tables.
Execution role injects env at task start
JSON call events + OpenTelemetry console spans
AWS management events → encrypted S3 bucket
Audit trail is separate from call analytics
Source: app/ + infra/template.yaml · See docs/architecture.md for component links, ingress conditions and execution limits.
